Not all regulated areas may be mapped. Boundary lines are a conceptual representation of TRCA's Regulation limit and should not be relied upon as a precise delineation. A feature or hazard does not have to be mapped to be regulated. See text of the Conservation Authorities Act and Ontario Regulation 41/24 for details.

Information in this viewer is not intended to constitute advice nor is it to be used as a substitute for specific advice from a qualified professional. You should not act, or refrain from acting, based upon information shown in the viewer without verifying the information with TRCA staff and, as necessary, obtaining professional advice regarding your particular facts and circumstances.
